summary: Compare a small declared set of alternatives on common criteria.
instructions: Declare alternatives, decision context, common criteria, and any stakeholder-supplied weights before scoring.
For each alternative/criterion, cite evidence, retain unknowns, and use comparable conditions and units. Never convert missing data into a zero score or invent a measurement.

Show sensitivity to assumptions/weights and explain dominated, incomparable, or tied options. Without justified weights or sufficient evidence, provide an unranked comparison and state what would resolve the decision.
